ctx-2 first simulation disagreed with the editor's displayed D and the subsequently generated M1 queue: Item 3 had empty V. Exact initial bytes are retained separately. After another completed Save, a rerun of the same input matched the queue: V 5, absent, D, 3. The initial attempt's effective compiled parameter and the cause of the discrepancy are unverified; it is not a semantic conclusion.
ctx-2 resolves the open question: a SUPPRESS-only context is not filled by mapWithDefault; a truly empty context receives D.

ctx-3 splitByValue Advanced parameter label is Context Change on; options are Each value (observed default), Empty value and Value change. Each value produces five Items with V a, a, empty, b, empty. Save and simulation completed without an error.
The ctx-3 variants use in-place edits of artifact ctx_3_each only after the preceding variant's exact output has been saved. Each variant is recorded under its request mapping name.
ctx-3-change changed only S1 and S2 to Value change after recording Each value. Save and simulation succeeded. It produced four Items with V [a,a], [empty string], [b], [empty string].

ctx-3-empty changed only S1 and S2 to Empty value after recording Value change. Save and simulation succeeded. It produced three Items with V [a,a], [b], then no V. Empty strings act as separators and are consumed; the trailing separator leaves an empty context. Artifact ctx_3_each is left in this final mode.

ctx-4 Save and simulation succeeded. exists in context Order gives true,true for two Sku values, false for each empty context, and true for a present empty-string Sku. This confirms the per-value candidate.
ctx-5 Save and simulation succeeded. collapseContexts keeps first values 3,10,7 and emits an empty string for the empty context. All four V values occur under Item 1; Items 2-4 are empty.

ctx-6a Save and simulation succeeded. All is 5t1,7t3, selecting the SUPPRESS-kept candidate. removeContexts preserves the SUPPRESS slot so Tag t2 stays paired with that slot. No fixed assumed result was specified.

ctx-6b is an in-place edit of artifact ctx_6a after its output was saved: retained constant/greater/ifWithoutElse, replaced both removeContexts branches and concat with collapseContexts -> All. Save and simulation succeeded. The result 5,7 contradicts the assumed 5,empty-string,7. CC queue confirms [5,SUPPRESS,7], so SUPPRESS is preserved rather than replaced with an empty string. Navigation after queue inspection warned of unsaved changes even after another Save; Yes returned to the package after all evidence was captured. Final persisted editor state was not rechecked.

spec2-sort-numeric-descending edits spec2_sort after both numeric ascending results were saved. Kept float number, selected desc=true. Save and simulation succeeded; case 007 confirms descending numeric order, stable equal values and preserved lexical forms.

spec2-suppress-sort-format rebuilds spec2_sort after all preceding results were saved: Tag context Orders -> createIf -> sort case sensitive/asc -> formatByExample, Sku context Order -> pattern, then All. Removed old removeContexts. Tree-to-canvas drag created two Sku boxes; removed unused duplicate. Five connections and both context titles verified. Save and simulation succeeded. Two empty All contradict assumed one; R1 queue confirms ascending puts SUPPRESS after empty strings.

spec2-suppress-sort-descending-format edits the same artifact only after the ascending output and queue were saved. Changed sort to desc=true. Save and simulation succeeded. One empty All contradicts assumed two; R1 queue confirms descending puts SUPPRESS first. Queue closed and final Save completed; no error/busy dialog and case sensitive/desc verified.
